# Disposable username and email component tests

Use only an isolated local backend on `127.0.0.1:3540/3541`, with a fresh database, no provider credentials, `--disable-beacon`, and `E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1` set in the backend before synchronization. Extract the unselected `.8` archive to `authpkg` inside a disposable copy of this fixture. Copy `email-fixture.ts.txt` to `authpkg/src/components/email/fixture.ts`; that seed/probe module is test-only and never enters the archive. Install dependencies in the disposable copy, then use `CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_URL` and a disposable local admin key to run `convex dev --once --typecheck disable --codegen disable`. Run `python3 test.py` and stop only the backend you started. The sender is an inert local mutation and never contacts an email provider.

The test seeds 201 attributed verified emails and challenges, races real component completion/start with email fencing and races username setting with username fencing, verifies batch bounds, replay, an unaffected user, an attributed recovery challenge, and a retained unattributed custom challenge. The synthetic seed is deliberately not a product endpoint. The test does not prove all normal auth flows, a live email delivery, other components, or complete account deletion.
